## Diagram Description

The ecosystem map shows all six products in the SZL Holdings portfolio and how they relate to the core Lyte + Alloy spine.

### Layout

```
                    SZL Holdings (Holding Company)
                           │
            ┌──────────────┤
            │              │
           Lyte          Alloy
      (Command Surface) (Execution Fabric)
            │
     ┌──────┼──────┬──────┐
     │      │      │      │
   Aegis  Vessels Terra  Carlota Jo
```

### Visual Hierarchy

- **SZL Holdings** — Center/top — amber/gold accent
- **Lyte** — Left branch — primary brand amber
- **Alloy** — Center branch — sky blue accent
- **Domain Packs** — Bottom row — unique color per vertical:
  - Aegis: indigo/violet (security)
  - Vessels: cyan (maritime)
  - Terra: green (real estate)
  - Carlota Jo: purple (advisory)

### Content Per Node

| Node | Label | Badge | Description |
|------|-------|-------|-------------|
| SZL Holdings | Platform Holding Company | — | Lyte · Alloy · Domain Packs |
| Lyte | Business Observability | FLAGSHIP | PRISM · Signal Timeline · Priority Queue · Exec Accountability |
| Alloy | Execution Fabric | FABRIC | Signal Routing · Approval Matrix · Audit Trail · Governance Policies |
| Aegis | Defense Intelligence | ALPHA | SOC · SOAR · MITRE ATT&CK |
| Vessels | Maritime Intelligence | ALPHA | AIS · Fleet · Sanctions |
| Terra | Real Estate Intelligence | ALPHA | Distress · Pipeline · Brokers |
| Carlota Jo | Advisory Operations | LIVE | Client Portal · Premium CRM |

## Regeneration

```bash
npx tsx scripts/media/generate-diagrams.ts
```

Or target only this diagram:

```bash
npx tsx scripts/media/generate-diagrams.ts --diagram ecosystem-map
```
